description: Get one workspace by id and return its full details, including defaults and the complete member list. Use this when you need membership detail; use list_workspaces for an overview.

workspace_id.description: The unique identifier of the workspace to retrieve. This can be found in the workspace's URL or from the list_workspaces tool response

name: get_workspace

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
